subject: math
topicName: Trigonometry: Law of Sines for AAS and ASA
description: Apply the Law of Sines to solve oblique triangles when two angles and one side are known.
learningObjectives: Explain why right-triangle ratios alone are not enough for oblique triangles
Identify AAS and ASA given information in an oblique triangle
Use the triangle angle sum to find a missing angle before applying the Law of Sines
Set up and solve Law of Sines proportions for missing sides
Check a complete Law of Sines solution using angle sum and opposite side-angle relationships
prerequisites: Angle and side naming in triangles
Rounding decimals to the nearest tenth
